notes.title: Wonderful adventure game Jenny LeClue - Detectivu is now fully voiced
notes.notes: Originally launching in September 2019 after a successful Kickstarter campaign, the mystery adventure Jenny LeClue - Detectivu just got a huge upgrade.

notes.title: A Gigantic Update Appears!
notes.notes:
Hi Super Sleuths!

We've been working away the past six months and I'm so excited to finally bring you...

[b]Jenny LeClue - Detectivu[/b]
[h1]SPOKEN SECRETS EDITION[/h1]

• Featuring voice acting for the entire game!!! 
• Play the game like an animated movie with new auto-play dialogue!
• Touch control improvements!
• Bug fixes galore!

We hope you enjoy! And if you find any issues, please don't hesitate to reach out to me at [url=mailto:support@mografi.com]support@mografi.com[/url]!

-Joe

[previewyoutube=Ob8n3wr8WFw;full][/previewyoutube]

1. Join Jenny LeClue in supporting Indie Megabooth’s Going Away Sale! Indie Megabooth has supported us and so many other indie devs over the years and we are offering Jenny LeClue at a 25% discount in their honor!

Until next time, happy detectiving!

notes.title: Spooky Halloween Costumes + 20% Discount!
notes.notes:
In celebration of Spooktober, we are discounting Jenny LeClue for a few days and we've added a Halloween themed costume set if you'd like to play with a little bit of extra spookiness!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/12697154/c0cc34b872da878060dfde379903b1540014ea2d.png[/img]

Today we are starting with a spooky and silly Halloween set. This costume sets update sets the groundwork for future cosmetic costume customization and themed sets! 

To try out Jenny's Spooktacular outfits, update the game, then simply go into the in-game options menu to change costumes. You can do this from the pause menu as well, in case you change your mind mid-game.

Happy Halloweenie detectives!

notes.title: Oh, and we added KEYBOARD REMAPPING!
notes.notes:
In the last post I forgot to mention one of the big features we added...

[h1]KEYBOARD REMAPPING![/h1]

-Joe

notes.title: Wot I Think: Jenny LeClue Detectiv
notes.notes:
Developer: Mografi
Publisher: Mografi

Release: Out now
On: Windows, Mac, Linux
From: GOG, Steam
Price: 16, $20, 19

All my way through playing Jenny LeClue: Detectiv , and increasingly as the game went on, I was certain my overriding opinion of the game would be heavily influenced by how it ended. So much of what the game is about, in terms of its narrative, its meta-narrative and its meta-meta-narrative, leans on its potential resolutions, and your expectations about what those might be. So it is with absolute utter bewilderment that I report to you: it has no ending.

Despite lasting a hefty 12-15 hours, and despite not a single word of warning in any of the game s promotional material, its store page, nor its Kickstarter, it suddenly ends on a to be continued . And I now have the unenviable task of explaining to you why that undermines every positive aspect of this sweet, funny, and beautiful game, without spoiling it.
